actors.name: Mayor Elena Vasquez
actors.private_context: Mayor Vasquez has threatened to veto the budget unless the council restores library funding. She is considering whether to sign or veto the budget before the October 1 deadline.

actors.name: Oakwood City Council
actors.private_context: The council passed a revised budget on September 14, which now awaits the mayor's signature. They are aware of the mayor's veto threat regarding library funding.

shared_context: The city council of Oakwood passed a revised budget on September 14, which now awaits the mayor's signature. The fiscal year begins October 1. The mayor has threatened a veto unless the council restores funding for the library.

starting_events.description: The revised budget from the city council is delivered to Mayor Vasquez for her signature or veto.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Mayor Vasquez signed the budget before October 1, 2026 at 23:59. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
